description: List the ongoing groups on The Living Bread that anyone can discover and join (prayer groups, study groups, city and interest communities), each with its member count, join policy (open or by request) and next posted gathering, filtered by an optional word and paged. Use when someone wants a group to belong to ("is there a prayer group", "a Bible study community in Atlanta"). Not for one-off events (find_gatherings_near), church buildings (find_churches_near) or live rooms right now (tables_live_now). Private family rooms are never listed. query is split into words and a community matches if ANY word appears in its name, description, kind, city or country, so "prayer Atlanta" widens rather than narrows; no match returns count 0. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

cursor.description: Opaque paging token: the next_cursor value from the previous answer of this same call. Omit for the first page.

query.description: Optional filter words matched against name, description, kind, city and country: "prayer", "study", "Atlanta". Omit to list all.

name: communities_to_join

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

communities.description: Each community: id (fetch with community:<id>), name, kind, its own description, city or "everywhere", member count, how to join, next posted gathering (UTC) or null, and whether it is verified.

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

count.description: Communities on this page; 0 when none matched.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as cursor for the next page; null when there is none.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

total.description: Total matching communities across all pages.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Communities a person can join
